day_local: Axadda soddonaad ee wakhtiga caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda iyo nimcada Ilaaha Aabbeheenna ah iyo Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jiraan.
penitential: Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso. Masiixow, noo naxariiso. Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
homily:
Waxaa jira daqiiqado nolosha ah oo u muuqda kuwo caadi ah, laakiin gudaha ku xambaarsan waxyaalo waaweyn. Bal ka fikir sawirka Ben oo ku jira qolka diyaaradda, gacmihiisa saaran kontoroolka, isagoo si dhab ah u eegaya dariiqa uu rabo inuu duuliyo. Waxay ahayd ciyaar, waxay ahayd riyo, waxay ahayd daqiiqad uu Ryan walaalkiis kula wadaagayay farxad iyo himilo. Maanta, akhriska koowaad ee Kitaabka Baxniintii wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaanan dadka kale ula dhaqmin si adag, ee aynu u naxariisano kuwa baahan. Waxaynu nahay dad loo yeeray inay jacaylkaas ku noolaadaan. Ciise, Injiilka maanta, wuxuu inoo dhigay aasaaska nolosha: 'Waa inaad Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah ka jeclaataa qalbigaaga oo dhan, naftaada oo dhan, iyo caqligaaga oo dhan.'

Benjamin Vo wuxuu ahaa wiil caqli badan. Wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay sida loo qoro koodhka, sida loo fahmo nidaamyada tiknoolajiyadda ee ugu adag, laakiin wuxuu ka sii horreeyay inuu barto jacaylka. Ma xasuusataan markuu u soo bandhigay inuu bixiyo lacagtiisa si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William? Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa dabeecadda wiilkan qalbiga wanaagsan. Taasi waa jacaylka Ciise inoo sheegayo. Jacayl aan xisaab lahayn. Jacayl aan shuruud lahayn.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaa jira saacado marka gurigu aamuso, oo aad dareemaysaan inaysan jirin wax buuxin kara cisrigaas banaanka ah. Waxaan rabaa inaan halkan ku hakinno. Waxaan rabaa inaan idiin sheego runta: Ilaah wuu idin arkaa. Wuxuu arkaa oohintiinna, wuxuu arkaa dadaalkiinna, wuxuu arkaa jacaylka aad weli u hayso Ben. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaan rabaa inaan si gaar ah u xuso in xanuunkan uusan ahayn khaladkiinna. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwa weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Midna isagu midna waalidkiis.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah.

Eeg, jacaylku waa sida diyaarad duulaysa oo aan marnaba joogsanayn. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil riyadiisu ahayd 'con chim airlines'. Wuxuu rabay inuu dadka kale kor u qaado, inuu dadka kale u muujiyo adduunka. Hadda, isagoo ku jira 'Banquet of Heaven', wuxuu sii wadaa inuu idin jeclaado. Wuxuu idin leeyahay, 'Ha cabsanin.' Wuxuu idin leeyahay, 'Waan idin arkaa.' Ryan, walaalkiis, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, xusuuso in Ben uu weli ku jiro wadnahaaga. Adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ha ka baqina inaad nolosha ku raaxaysataan, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdaan.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in jacaylka Ilaah uu yahay kan ku haya. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku jirto Sakramentka Quduuska ah. Waan ku jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan kugu qaato naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda kugu qaadan karin Sakramentka, fadlan igu soo gal naftayda si ruuxi ah. Waxaan ku duubayaa naftayda adiga, ha ii oggolaan inaan waligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabad maanta iyo weligeedba.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna qaaliga ah ee Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii ka horreeyay, inuu Ilaah u naxariisto oo uu ku soo dhoweeyo iftiinkiisa weligeed ah.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan iyo kuwa xanuunka haya, inuu Ilaah u soo dejiyo nabad, rajo, iyo xoog ay ku sii wadaan nolosha.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Sayidku wuxuu leeyahay: 'Ha dhibin ama ha dulmin qariibka, waayo idinkuba qariib baad ku ahaydeen dalka Masar. Ha dulmin carmal ama agoomaha. Haddii aad weligaa dulmido oo ay ii qayliyaan, hubaal waan maqli doonaa qayladooda. Cadhadaydu way kici doontaa, oo waxaan idinku dili doonaa seefta; markaas naagihiinnu waxay noqon doonaan carmal, carruurtiinnuna agoomo. Haddii aad lacag amaahiso mid ka mid ah deriskaaga saboolka ah ee dadkayga ka mid ah, ha u dhaqmin sida dulmiye oo kale adigoo dulsaar ka dalbanaya. Haddii aad qaadato marada deriskaaga oo ballan ah, waa inaad u soo celisaa ka hor qorrax dhaca; waayo maradan isaga uun baa u ah dhar uu jidhkiisa ku asturo. Maxaa kale oo uu ku seexanayaa? Haddii uu ii qayliyo, waan maqli doonaa; waayo anigu waan naxariis badanahay.'

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Waan ku jeclahay, Rabbiyow, xooggaygiiyow. Waan ku jeclahay, Rabbiyow, xooggaygiiyow, Rabbiyow, dhagaxaygiiyow, qalcadaygiiyow, badbaadiyahaygiiyow. R. Waan ku jeclahay, Rabbiyow, xooggaygiiyow. Ilaahaygiiyow, dhagaxaygiiyow oo aan magan galo, gaashankaygiiyow, geeska badbaadaygaygiiyow, munaaradaygiiyow! Rabbiga waa la ammaanayaa, ayaan ku dhawaaqayaa, oo cadowgayga ayaan ka badbaadayaa. R. Waan ku jeclahay, Rabbiyow, xooggaygiiyow. Rabbigu wuu nool yahay, ha la barakeeyo dhagaxayga! Ilaaha badbaadiyahayga ha la weyneeyo. Adiga oo boqorkaaga guul weyn siiyey oo naxariis u muujiyey kii aad subagtay. R. Waan ku jeclahay, Rabbiyow, xooggaygiiyow.

readings.label: Akhriska Labaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal: Waxaad og tihiin nooca dadka aan idinku dhex ahayn aawadiin. Waxaadna noqoteen kuwo na dayda anaga iyo Rabbiga, idinkoo ereyga ku helay dhib weyn, farxad Ruuxa Quduuska ah ka timid, si aad u noqoteen tusaale dhammaan aaminnada Masedoniya iyo Achaia. Waayo, idinka xaggiinna ereyga Rabbiga ayaa ka dhex guuxay, kaliya ma aha Masedoniya iyo Achaia, laakiin meel kasta oo rumaysadkiinna Ilaah ku leeyahay ayaa gaadhay, sidaa darteed uma baahnin inaan wax sheegno. Waayo, iyaga qudhoodu waxay si cad uga hadlayaan nooca soo dhaweynta aan idinka helnay, iyo sida aad Ilaah ugu soo jeesateen sanamyada, si aad ugu adeegtaan Ilaaha nool oo runta ah, iyo inaad sugtaan Wiilkiisa samada ka imanaya, ka uu ka soo sara kiciyey kuwii dhintay, Ciise, kaas oo inaga badbaadiya cadhada soo socota.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Markii Farrisiintu maqleen in Ciise uu aamusiyey Sadduqiyiinta, way isugu yimaadeen, mid ka mid ah oo ahaa sharci yaqaan ayaa imtixaanay isagoo waydiinaya, 'Macallimow, waa tuma amarka ugu weyn sharciga?' Wuxuu ku yidhi, 'Waa inaad Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah ka jeclaataa qalbigaaga oo dhan, naftaada oo dhan, iyo caqligaaga oo dhan. Kanu waa amarka ugu weyn oo ugu horreeya. Kan labaadna waa la mid: Waa inaad deriskaaga u jeclaataa sida naftaada. Sharciga oo dhan iyo nebiyaduba waxay ku xidhan yihiin labadan amar.'

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
